name: Blue mistflower
desc: Blue mistflower (Conoclinium coelestinum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Conoclinium coelestinum, commonly known as blue mistflower, mistflower, wild ageratum, or blue boneset, is a North American species of herbaceous perennial flowering plant in the family Asteraceae.
